name: Microgrid intertie opening-request boundary
aliases: microgrids Microgrid topology and earthing coordination
summary: Identifies the authorized opening request to the assigned interconnection device.
description: Identifies the authorized opening request to the assigned interconnection device. Microgrid topology control tracks which sources and load sections are electrically connected. The same physical installation can form several islands, so source roles, measurement boundaries and earthing interfaces must follow the established configuration.

In a microgrid with sectionalized buses, the controller can associate each connected source and load group with its current island. A mode-dependent neutral or protection interface needs its own independently validated design. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Separation request and authority” at the input and “Intertie opening command” at the output. Opening feedback is a separate signal.

Keep measured switch positions, logical island assignment and any earthing command separate. A conceptual topology block cannot establish a safe neutral-switching arrangement or prove that a circuit is de-energized. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
